nom: DHC Face Wash Powder Facial Cleanser

avis.texte: I love the DHC brand, and use several of their products. This is a wonderful cleanser. It exfoliates gently, and never irritates my sensitive skin. I use the Deep Cleansing Oil at night and this in the morning. I sometimes use this as a double cleanse at night, and it never dries my skin, even if I use both products.

This is a good, mild cleanser that's easy to use because the rather rinses right off. My face feels good afterward - no burn, no tightness, etc. The Foaming Mesh is helpful, but be careful - the powder goes right through the mesh, so make sure you have one hand underneath the mesh when you sprinkle the powder on.
I've been using this face wash powder for years and love it. It's gentle, minimal plastic and it's a great price. Will continue to use it as long as they make it.

I have used this product for years and love it. A little bit of this soft powder poured into the hand with a splash of water, produces a luxurious lather that effectively removes any remaining makeup. I use the cleansing oil first, then rotate between this washing powder or the olive soap as a second cleanse. My skin is left feeling soft and clean. The added bonus is you can easily travel with this as it's not a liquid. Perfect cleanser!

avis.titre: The Cleanser You Didn't Know You Needed
avis.texte: I saved my Face Wash Powder for way too long in my closet awaiting a trip for which a powder cleanser would save me issues with TSA. However, a couple of years ago, it came with me for 8 days. I'm offically a fan. It is a very gentle exfoliant as well as a cleanser. The face wash powder has been in my normal rotation of cleansers ever since. I like it especially on those days when I've been active outdoors. I feel as if it cleanses the sweat, dirt etc.. while also giving my skin a good cleaning.

A very small amount creates a soothing lather. My face feels smooth and wonderful afterwards. But the best part is that it immediately cleans your pores and within a short week my oily zone became clear and free of bumps. Great to take on trips also.

I have been using and loving this face wash for 20 years. I am so upset that it's been discontinued! Please consider bringing it back. Also, if there's any leftover just laying around please let me know. I'll take them!
Skin issues at 68, including acne . Even having used products from my dermatologist- this is the best product ever. I use a small amount of powder, moisten with deep cleansing oil, lightly rub, rinse
I use this powder cleanser everyday! It's also so easy to travel with! Weighs hardly nothing and since it's not liquid I can take it on a plane in a carry-on!
I like this product, but I can't use it daily because it leaves my skin surface looking stripped

avis.titre: Pops up when searching for sulfur acne wash -its not
avis.texte: This acne wash pops up when searching for sulfur acne wash. While it does not contain sulfur it has worked great for the consistent black heads I've had on my nose for years. It is gentle and non drying. My fungal acne is minimized but not gone.

I've been using this for 25 years. Simply the best. Oh and btw, the best travel face wash. At 56 yo, I have to be picky at what I can bring for liquids in my carry-on, and this is perfect! since it doesn't count towards my quart-sized bag! Love it!
This has been a staple in my weekly routine. Even though I have sensitive, dry skin, I use it once a week to clarify pores and get a deeper clean. My skin feels soft and refreshed afterwards.
Even having more sensitive skin, can still use this product every so often, it exfoliates well and can use with another cleanser.
Foams nicely, but does not remove makeup well. My eyeshadow was still there after washing.

I am on my 2nd bottle. I love this. Wet your face, while your hands are still wet sprinkle with powder, rub hands together and apply to your face. The lather gets so thick and foamy. The directions say don't get in your eyes, of course by mistake I did just that, it didn't burn. I have read so many reviews that compare this product to the Dermalogica powder cleanser which is very expensive. This is a mild exfoliating cleaner , it does not dry out your skin . I use it everyday.
This soap powder is convenient and easy to use. The travel size is perfect.
I really like this face wash powder. It makes my skin feel clean but not stripped!
First of all, this product is so cool to use. I love how it changes from powder to liquid. And secondly, it works! On my, acne, whiteheads, and blackheads! It is truly effective!
Grate size and light in weight perfect for travel instead of the tube face wash to heavy for travel🌺

avis.titre: Best Buddy at Home and Travel
avis.texte: If you travel this product is for you! No worry with having a liquid or gel. However, I also use it at home. It's one of my 2nd cleanse products. It is gentle and has a light lather.

avis.titre: Powder makes it perfect for travel cleanser.
avis.texte: Product is easy to pack and, since it isn't liquid, perfect for travel.

Again I was skeptical but after using the water friend cleansing oil by DHC, I use about a dime size of this powder and a little water and you can feel the creaminess of this cleanser. My face has not been dry or irritated. The entire DHC if so amazing
This product is one of my favorites because it's so clean to use. Just a little powder mixed with water and it perfectly cleans ones skin. Love it
I love this brand… it has done wonders for me. I love the way my skin feels after cleansing. I also use the deep cleansing oil and I'm loving it. My skin feels hydrated and clean.
Best face wash ever. Haven't got a clue why DHC stopped carrying it.

I have a hard time finding face wash to use at the end of the day that removes all makeup without completely stripping and drying my skin but this wash does great. I like that's it's a little gritty at first but then desolves so does not really scratch or damage skin.
I use this with another cleanser for double clean and to remove dead skin cells .

I've received samples of this powdered face wash and finally tried it this summer while visiting Hawaii. I liked it so much that I ordered the full-size product. It's perfect for travel because you don't have to worry about TSA liquids requirements, so it can go in a carry-on bag. I have dry, aging skin and would not use this in the dry climate at home. But for the damp climate in Hawaii (where I travel frequently to see family) it is perfect to clean away the sweat of the day and gently exfoliate.
This really removes the last bit of soil after washing with another product
I have used this for many years and love the product and not the mess of a bar of soap.

avis.titre: Exra love for this product.  No gritty sandy face
avis.texte: I love this lightly exfoliating face wash. I use it once a week and it really foams up nicely.
I usually use the Olive Soap but when I travel and in my shower the washing powder is great. It doesn't dry my skin out and preps it for other DHC products.
Love this for Travel easy to take anywhere. Keep one in my purse

Alright, i do think that this product js a very good cleanser. It is inexpensive, esepcially for how long it will last with how little product you use each wash. It has a really nice lather to it and leaves your skin feeling very clean. I am definitely making this my travel face wash for when im flying and need to limit liquids. However, it isnt one that i want to use regularly at home only because it has that "rubbery" skin feeling after you use it like certain soaps do and that is personally a big pet peeve of mine. Also it didnt dry my skin out entirely, but i didnt feel like it hydrated it quite enough. 3.5/5, for me its only alright but i can see how some people moght love it. 33, acne prone combination skin.
Why did you discontinue this? That was my favorite face wash…
Love the clean feeling skin that I get with this foaming cleanser!

avis.titre: SOO GOOD FOR ALL SKIN TYPES!!
avis.texte: First off id like to say i have like extremely oily skin!! i got this product as a free sample and i was immediately extremely impressed. the next day i went to buy it!! As soon as i rinsed this off my face felt sooo soft and hyrdated. it brightened my skin and my face had that natural glow from within look and appearance wise so much more brighter and radiant!! I was so shocked tbh. this is amazing if you have sensitive skin aswell. The past couple days ive been using this its faded my blemishs and these tiny dots on my face ive been struggling to get rid of! it takes a couple times to fully learn how to properly use but one you do its amazing. Since i have super oily skin my skin usually hates hyrdating and super creamy cleansers but this is literally the only exception lmaoo. i would totally recommend trying this. price is also really fair!

avis.titre: It's perfect.  Gentle, foams nicely and cleans well.
avis.texte: This is a perfect cleanser. Even with a small amount of powder, it foams easily. Its gentle, yet effective. Unlike the Good Molecules enzyme cleanser, this doesn't have a gritty texture or any physical exfoliation properties. It'll dissolve with water completely. I would purchase both products to serve different needs. I'm tepurchasing!

I bought this on a whim and I absolutely love it! Its a bit of trial & error to find the perfect pour, but once you find it, its magic. It cleans so well & somehow manages to brighten & hydrate my dry skin.

I have very sensitive skin, so this product really helps. My face is clean, smooth, no oily spots around nose, no break out & doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I'm 76 years old, have been using this product for years with no worries. Highly recommended.
love this product lasts forever makes my skin so soft for an older person
This is a fun product, along with being a gentle, effective cleanser. I bought the travel size to try it out.

This product got rid of all of my blackheads and texture after ONE USE. Im not one to leave reviews but I am so impressed by this product. I have very sensitive skin, there are a handful of products i can use without causing irritation and breakouts. After ONE USE my skin was so smooth and it evened out the texture of my skin. Cant wait to see how my skin will look after using this for a while!
I love this product. It's a mild exfoliant and leaves my face feeling wonderful

We k let me tell you that I wasn't sure if I was gonna like this product but reading the good reviews decided to give it a try and I'm so glad I did!! I use it with the DHC cleansing Oil it leaves my skin clean and soft. Will continue using

I've never tjought I would like this powder so much!!! I use it with DHC cleansing oil and it removes all dirt and makeup and leaves me with that "glass " skin look. I have combination skin type and this is a keeper.
It didn't make my skin feel any special way or do anything extraordinary. Definitely messy. Feels gimmicky.

avis.titre: Almost Perfect but not Cruelty-Free and Little Exfoliation
avis.texte: I have been looking for a facial exfoliation wash similar to Tatcha's or Dermatologica's but at a better price point. I was excited to discover DHC on Ulta's website and instantly fell in love with them! Cost is great, the packaging is nice and minimalist in feel, they have a good range of J-beauty cornerstone products, they're made in Japan, and are often used in luxury spas and hotels in Japan. Product-wise, this powder wash combines with water to make a foamy, fluffy face wash that's great on sensitive skin. I thought it was an exfoliant wash at the time of purchase but there isn't much in the way of remaining granules once you wet the product to exfoliate with. The reason I won't be repurchasing is because this brand was initially listed under Ulta's cruelty-free brands and has since been removed. Upon further research, DHC does not test on animals but they do outsource animal testing to other companies to sell in countries where animal testing is required by law. I might consider repurchasing if not for the animal testing component and wish DHC would stop distributing in counties requiring animal testing.
This lathers up nicely. Leaves my skin feeling clean, but not dried out. The fact that it's a powder in a container keeps my counter clean and neat as well.
there is something about the feel of this, the ritual that is so satisfying and good. my face feels so soft and clean after.
Why does a company take a product with excellent reviews and discontinue it? It's a mystery to me. I'm so sad.

I bought this DHC wash powder in Japan, and it came with a mesh wash net (like a mesh scrubby). Wet the net, add a little wash powder to the net, work up lots of foamy lather, and collect the lather in your hands to wash your face. Not necessary I guess, but I'm easily entertained and it lets me use less powder. In your double cleanse routine this goes after your cleansing oil/balm step: I can't use DHC cleansing oil without it. Keep in mind, you will need to remove waterproof cosmetics separately. Still, I will ALWAYS have this wash powder on hand in my bathroom and travel bag.

I live in the South. Humidity makes my face feel oily. I also have rosacea and sensitive skin. I use this EVERY day. It leaves my face feeling clean and fresh, and never causes rosacea or sensitivity issues. PLEASE NEVER DISCONTINUE THE FACE WASH POWDER! It's the only thing I found that I can continually use without issues!

avis.titre: The only face wash I can (could) use.
avis.texte: This face wash saved me. I have dry, sensitive skin and this product is gentle enough to cleanse without drying, but effective in keeping my skin clear. I don't know what I'm going to do now that it's discontinued.

This was part of the original DHC sample pack when the products only came from Japan and DHC was trying to break into the US market. It is THE reason I began a loyal customer and tried other products in the lineup. It is so good that even my husband uses iit. PLEASE DO NOT DISCONTINUE !!!

avis.titre: This is my favorite face cleanser.
avis.texte: Please do not discontinue!!!!! I love this product, I have been using it daily for years. It has greatly improved my skin.

avis.titre: It's good but doesn't help with removing makeup
avis.texte: I wear a full face if makeup throughout the day and the cleanser does a terrible job of removing it , it did take some off but I had to excessively scrub my face which is bad for your skin , I have combination skin which is mostly on the oily side and when trying to remove my makeup it makes it like a waterproof substance that doesn't come off until I grab some soap and take it off , it's good for a clean face but not for makeup removal
This is my go to product to wash my face. Love that I can control the amount, it rinse's off easily and my skin is always soft and cleanses. Repeat purchase for me.

A small amount of powder turns into a lush foaming, slightly exfoliating scrub. It's so easy to use and so portable and packable. I like to use this as a second cleanse in my double cleanse after using DHC oil cleanser.
God bless this gentle, effective, fun-to-use exfoliator, please never ever stop stocking this.

avis.titre: Keep your skin clean and radiant
avis.texte: best product ever for cleaning aging skin. Use morning and night.
The smallest drop of water turns this into a butter foam !! Literally do soft and smooth on the face ! Very pleasantly surprised
Excellent cream, good for my sensitive skin. I use it at night
Love this product. It is so gentle, but it exfoliates!? Your skin feels so soft and smooth after use.
I bought this to take on my carry on. Foams up nicely with a slight exfoliation.
This is simply the best facial cleaner. Cleanses without leaving my skin dry.
The best face wash! Gentle but gets the job done. Exfoliâtes gently too.
This is my favorite facial cleanser. It's gentle to my sensitive skin, I need only a small amount to clean my face and it feels luxurious.

avis.titre: Powser Face Wash Cleanses & Dispenses With Ease
avis.texte: I like using the face wash powder because I can control the amount of powder. Better than liquid pump bottle
I love this product. It cleans without perfumes or stripping the skin. It last a long time.
I like face wash as I feel very clean and fresh after I use it for daily. You only need a small volume of products but it cleaned it all. I will recommend to my friend.

avis.titre: An effective alternative to bar soap
avis.texte: I decided to try the Face Wash for the convenience as opposed to soap bars. I am satisfied with it as it cleanses my skin as well as the Olive Soap I have used for years. Its only downside is that it leaves my skin feeling a bit tight, much as the Mild Soap had done, and I need to rush into the rest of my routine, or at least apply the Mild Lotion as soon as possible. Overall, I recommend this cleanser.

It just dissolved to a watery substance when moistened. The powder is soo finely ground to get any abrasion while washing. I added a little baking soda to the bottle to give it some oomph. Works better now. Also hate the plastic bottle.
Pleasant, effective, does not strip skin, makes great foam using the mesh fabric, a little goes a long way. Works very well after deep cleansing oil. Love this product!
Very similar to the Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant but without the gross smell and at a fraction of the cost .

I have tried many, many cleansers and moisturizers on my sensitive, rosacea prone face and this gentle wash has been the best of all of them. I wash with this and then use the Olive Virgin Oil Crystal Skin Essence with a tiny amount of the Olive Virgin Oil Essential Cream. This trio has left my 65 yr. old sensitive skin soft, smooth, and free of redness and bumps that had before. Please don't ever discontinue this!
I can't live without this product. I wish a similar product came as a full body powder wash. It leaves my face super silky and soft. I now double cleanse morning and night.
Glad I got this. I have combo / dry skin and it's very gentle and cleansing

I like the fact that you don't need a lot to get lots of suds. I use it after the DHC Deep Cleansing oil like is recommended. It leaves my skin really, really clean. I think I'm sticking to these two face washes.

avis.titre: The best face wash powder ever?!
avis.texte: This is such an amazing face wash! I have extremely dry, sensitive skin and this face wash is one of only a few that I can use without any irritation whatsoever! It leaves your skin soft and does not strip your skin if it's natural oils! I love this one just as much as the Dermalogica microfoliant, I use that when I need a deep clean with aha's and bha's. This is a great face wash!
Amazingly gentle but effective cleansing. My skin feels great after I wash. I use it at night so far.
This is a great product to bring when traveling. No liquid to spill and make a mess.

avis.titre: Used this for years, love it!
avis.texte: I use this after the deep cleansing oil and it just is so clean and light without drying.
In agreement w/pretty much everything in the 5 star reviews, the exception is that it doesn't clear existing blackheads/blemishes.

I don't write reviews very often but this product is AMAZING! Highly Recommend! 1.) It didn't break me out 2.) Having used it over 2 week, my skin is soft and radiant. 3.) The product doesn't strip my skin, it feel incredible! 4.) There isn't a fragrance, so my skin didn't relate badly when I started to use it. Will purchase AGAIN! 5.) Gets rid of my textured skin in areas as my cheeks and forehead.

Amazing product! I have tried so many different skincare products that have enzyme powder cleanser, and this is one of the BEST PRODUCTS I HAVE EVER USED! I love this brand and I was so excited to try their enzyme powder as a part of my double cleanse, and I am absolutely sure that this is definitely one that I will continue to repurchase over and over again. This one gets my skin clean and my pores clear.
i really want to love this cleanser but it just doesn't feel like it really cleans my skin. i love dhc products but i don't think i'll be repurchasing.
I love how easily this "soaps up" with such a small amount, deep cleans and rinse off so easily! It's my go-to always!

This product was literally Heaven sent. It took me years to find the DHC brand, and I'm so happy I finally did. All of their products are inexpensive and magical. My favorite thing about this product is that you don't need a ton of it to clean off an entire face of makeup. It lathers VERY well, which is huge for me. And, it actually lasts a really long time even with everyday use.

I love this cleansing action. Different that a traditional soap. At first I was skeptical, but now I use it all the time. It's very economical since only a little powder makes a lot creamy cleansing. My skin doesn't feel tight or dry afterwards.

avis.titre: Don't let the little bottle fool you!
avis.texte: I gave this bottle the side eye when I got it because how small it was, but this stuff will last me a LONG time!! You seriously only need a SMALL pea size amount and it does the job. I use this with the DHC cleansing oil as a 2-step cleanse... and my skin is looking so much better!! Usually after washing my face.. it would go back to having my stupid oily zones looking gross again no matter what routine I tried, but I was amazed after only the 2nd time using this new combo, my face wasnt as oily as it usually would get... my skin is usually oily/combo with the oily parts getting super oily, and now my skin is starting to behave like its 'normal' skin. Absolutely will continue to use and purchase!!!
I love the face wash powder because it washes off quickly and cleans my oily skin without drying it or leaving it oily. It's perfect.
This is the face wash I've been looking for! Leaves my mature sensitive skin feeling soothed, never dry. Nice fragrance.

I have oily and acne prone skin and the DHC face wash powder is the BEST cleanser ever! This product cleans my face without over drying it and it balances out my skin tone. My skin looks better each time I use this product! I LOVE it! ❤️
i use it at a second cleanse after my oil cleanser and it makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated it also calms down some redness on my mildly inflamed brown skin

avis.titre: Face wash powder= very clean face
avis.texte: Really creamy facial wash, superb cleaning without stripping, and I have sensitive skin too.... Very happy with it.....
My first choice for a face cleanser. Lathers richly and rinses clean. Economical, great value for the money.

avis.titre: This is the greatest travel facial cleanser!
avis.texte: This is the greatest travel facial cleanser! I have used this for years when I travel, now I am suing the washing powder for everyday too. It's convenient and not messy!
This face wash is effective, gentle, thorough, and lasts a long time.

Perfect as a standalone or double-cleanse cleanser! It's really light while still being effective and non-drying. Just a small little dollop turns into a lovely creamy foam. Just know that it doesn't take waterproof mascara off all the way, so if you're an eye makeup wearer like me, it's best to use this AFTER using a makeup remover or another oil-based cleanser for the best results in the evening. But, it does seem to get my sunscreen off pretty effectively on its own, so if you don't wear makeup this could work for you. (I use it as a standalone cleanser on days I don't wear makeup.) Love how clean and fresh this makes my skin feel. The current bottle makes it easy to dispenses day-to-day amounts, and could see how the battle would be perfect for traveling. Knowing that I'm already going to reorder in the future, would love if it if I could get refills in more eco-friendly packaging (like paper pouch).

I really wanted to love this product, but unlike other reviewers, this cleanser makes the dry areas of my face even drier. Specifically my eyelids and outer cheeks; they get so dry that it starts to burn (like a sunburn, even though I'm stuck indoors because of COVID) and I have to use Aquaphor to lessen the discomfort. I have sensitive combination skin and I'm allergic to fragrances. This product gets 3 stars because it does not trigger any allergy-related rashes and it cleanses well the oily areas of my face. It has also not triggered my acne-prone skin. I would only recommend it for those with sensitive and super oily skin, but not for dry skin. I'm so sad because other reviews mentioned that this cleanser is good for dry skin... It makes me question if maybe I received a bad batch... It could have been perfect for me, but the burning dryness is a major deal breaker...

Bought this product for the first time recently and had used for around a week with no problems. However, in the past few days my skin texture has completely changed and I have broke out with small bumps all over my face. My face also feels tight and itchy at times. It's definitely this product that has caused the reaction, as all my other products I have been using for weeks or months with no irritation. I think maybe because this product is exfoliating as well as cleansing... I also use chemical exfoliants about 3 times a week and doing that in combination with this product was obviously not good idea! Would recommend not using this product if you also exfoliate with serums/washes often. It's a shame as I love DHC, especially their cleansing oil!
I love that the product is powder and turns into this foaming facewash .
This is genuinely a nice simple face wash. I love how it foams up but it doesn't leave my skin stripped whatsoever! Will also last so long because you need the tiniest bit!

avis.titre: Cleans Well & Makes My Skin Feel Great!
avis.texte: My skin used to not be able to tolerate this wash powder, but things have changed with my skin, and I now find it leaves my skin feeling so smooth and wonderful. If I'm feeling a bit parched, I use the Olive Soap, which is another wonderful product!
gentle face powder wash and very easy to use and carry for traveling. Makes a lot of foam when used with facial net wash.
I use this along with the olive oil cleanser and it leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth!

Pour a little into your palm, add drops of water from your other hand (don't place directly under running water), and briefly work into a lather before applying to your face. It turns it into a rich lather and feels great. It's finer than the Tatcha rice wash - that one stays grittier longer and feels a bit like a physical exfoliant. There's no grit to this one. Washes away clean.
I love this DHC Cleanser. It cleans well and leaves my face feeling clean and fresh.
One of the best on the market! My husband and I both use it and love it. Gentle yet leaves your skin feeling fresh.

avis.titre: The lather is so thick and creamy
avis.texte: This wash is luxurious. The smallest amount of powder, once a bit of water is added, turns into this thick, soft foam. It doesn't strip your skin or make it tight. Thoroughly cleanses. Reasonably priced and great for travel.
Love this face wash! It washes all my make up off and leaves my face soft and clean without any tightness.
I bought this because the gimmick sounded fun, but I actually love it and plan on continuing to use it. It has no perceivable fragrance, and is gentle yet thorough.
